liebermann.description_de: Verlorene Vorlage von G und ls für Af-Ine und II. III Eg
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: Posited by Liebermann: a common source of G and ls, inferred from the readings they share. No such manuscript survives.
liebermann.laws: Af, Ine, II Eg, III Eg
liebermann.notes: A common source of G and ls for Alfred–Ine and II–III Edgar, posited by Liebermann.

others.text: Wormald (1999, p. 265) finds Liebermann’s account of the manuscripts of Alfred’s law-book too flawed to reproduce.
